ModMetaData.name: Armor Integrity (Prototype)
ModMetaData.author: PhillipFrei
ModMetaData.description: Prototype armor overhaul. Armor loses effectiveness as it is worn down. Apparel uses real hit points; intrinsic armor from genes, implants, races and other pawn stats uses a regenerating Battered state. Penetration is handled layer by layer. No forced minimum damage or blunt-trauma system is included yet.
